baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَخَذْنَا مِيثَاقَ ... وَأَرْسَلْنَا links taking a covenant to sending envoys.
baseline_models.mechanism: Taking and binding secure a prior relation, while sending releases a succession of carriers toward its addressees. Each arrival therefore tests an already operative bond rather than opening an unrelated episode.

activation_trace.role: Gathering and holding supplies the secured side of the covenant mechanism.
Binding and tethering make the covenant an operative restraint rather than a background promise.
Sending and release supply the outward movement that repeatedly brings the bond under test.
Successive batches make the threefold envoy wording a serial relay.

changed_reading.before: A covenant was made, and messengers were subsequently sent.
changed_reading.after: The covenant is a held relation serviced and stress-tested by a continuing dispatch of messengers.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: بِمَا لَا تَهْوَى أَنفُسُهُمْ فَرِيقًا كَذَّبُوا وَفَرِيقًا يَقْتُلُونَ makes inner inclination precede two object fates.
baseline_models.mechanism: Mismatch between carried content and inward inclination turns the receiving side into a sorter of the arriving envoy stream. The repeated fronted فَرِيقًا partitions bearers into two treated classes: denial attacks credibility, while killing attacks the living carrier.

activation_trace.role: The self's inclination supplies the preference gate applied to incoming content.
The inward faculty of mind and awareness locates the gate within the receivers.
Distinguishing between two supplies the sorting operation marked by the repeated object.
Attributing a person or claim to falsehood supplies reputational elimination.
Taking life supplies bodily elimination as the second output.

changed_reading.before: The audience dislikes the preaching, then some deny and some kill.
changed_reading.after: The receiving selves classify successive unwelcome bearers into reputational or bodily erasure; the two parties are the treated objects, not two innocent descriptions of the audience.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: كُلَّمَا frames repetition, while كَذَّبُوا is perfect and يَقْتُلُونَ is imperfect.
baseline_models.mechanism: Every arrival is a repeatable occasion. Completed denial reads as an accumulated record, while imperfect killing remains durative or habitual, so the verse looks backward yet leaves lethal response grammatically open.

activation_trace.role: All-encompassing iteration gives each arrival membership in a recurring pattern.
Falsehood supplies the completed response whose perfect form accumulates as record.
Lethal action supplies the response whose imperfect form remains ongoing or recurrent.

changed_reading.before: Both denial and killing are closed events in a past report.
changed_reading.after: Denial is tallied as past practice, but killing is voiced as a still-repeatable habit within every-arrival time.

context_deltas.mechanism: Before the focus, the same taking-root governs making allies and making religion or prayer into mockery and play. Against those appropriative takings, taking the covenant becomes an ordered relation that regulates what may be made one's own.

activation_trace.role: Taking hold supplies the covenantal act against which the earlier acts are contrasted.
Making or acquiring covers both prohibited alliance-taking and taking religion as mockery, exposing rival ways of constituting relations.
Making prayer into mockery repeats the instrumental appropriation immediately before the covenant wording.

structural_cues: 5:57 nests لَا تَتَّخِذُوا around actors who اتَّخَذُوا دِينَكُمْ as mockery and play.
5:58 repeats the conversion of prayer into mockery and play.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one root across covenant, affiliation, and instrumentalized worship; I infer a contrast between binding relation and self-serving appropriation. A live alternative is that the repetitions only coordinate nearby admonitions.

changed_reading.before: God simply obtained a promise from the addressees.
changed_reading.after: God's taking establishes the binding relation that should govern later takings, while the surrounding takings show sacred relations being remade for convenience.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus sends a bearer who comes carrying content; 5:61 reverses the direction as suspect speakers come to the believing community, enter and exit with disbelief, and conceal it. Arrival becomes a threshold that diagnoses what the receiver carries inwardly as well as what the messenger carries in.

activation_trace.role: Coming with and bringing joins the messenger's arrival to carried content.
The visitors' coming reverses who approaches whom and makes the encounter a mirrored threshold.
Entering an interior supplies the inbound crossing while disbelief remains the visitors' cargo.
Passing outward completes a crossing that leaves the concealed interior unchanged.
Hiding and covering distinguish performed belief from the inward state exposed by the crossing.

structural_cues: 5:61 places a spoken claim of belief between coming and the paired entry-exit movements.
The directional movements are public, while the final object is what they conceal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mirrored comings, carried states, and an inside-outside sequence; I infer that arrival functions diagnostically. Alternatively, 5:61 may describe a separate social encounter without defining messenger reception.

changed_reading.before: Coming only describes the messenger's physical approach.
changed_reading.after: Coming is a diagnostic boundary event: the incoming message meets and reveals the receiver's own concealed cargo.

context_deltas.mechanism: Private aversion scales into denial and killing when no feedback channel interrupts it. 5:63 assigns braking responsibility to learned leaders, and 5:79 describes reciprocal failure among participants; the two fates imposed on messengers become terminal outputs of an unregulated social system.

activation_trace.role: Inner inclination supplies the initial pressure that requires social restraint.
The two distinguished outputs expose what the failed restraint system ultimately permits.
Killing marks the endpoint of escalation when no brake stops action.
Restraint and desistance supply the missing institutional brake on harmful speech and consumption.
Reciprocal failure to restrain supplies the network-level absence of correction.

structural_cues: 5:62 says many hasten into sin and aggression; 5:63 asks why authorities do not restrain their speech and consumption.
5:79 uses reciprocal يَتَنَاهَوْنَ after 5:78 names disobedience and repeated transgression.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies acceleration, two failed restraint sites, and the focus's escalating outputs; I infer a causal path from absent correction to violence. The live alternative is a catalogue of distinct communal offenses rather than one feedback mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Denial and killing are isolated reactions by individual receivers.
changed_reading.after: The reactions are socially produced endpoints: appetite goes unchecked by leaders and peers until an unwelcome bearer can be discredited or removed.

context_deltas.mechanism: 5:64 repeats كُلَّمَا for kindling war and divine extinguishing. Beside 5:70's every-arrival sequence, the messenger encounter becomes one phase of an ignition cycle in which unwelcome communication is repeatedly converted into conflict and then checked.

activation_trace.role: Encompassing each occurrence supplies the repeated arrival frame.
Successive dispatched groups supply fresh inputs to the recurring cycle.
Killing is the focus's embodied conflict output.
The matching every-time construction makes war ignition a structural analogue of messenger arrival.
Igniting fire supplies the conversion from opposition into active conflict.
War and hostility identify the social domain of the ignition.
The flame's subsiding supplies an external interruption that the receivers do not provide themselves.

structural_cues: 5:64 and 5:70 share the marked كُلَّمَا recurrence frame.
The earlier cycle explicitly alternates human ignition with divine extinguishing; the focus alternates messenger arrival with human rejection.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two repeated sequences and their violent terms; I infer that message rejection feeds the same conflict circuit. They may instead be parallel recurrence patterns without a direct causal arrow.

changed_reading.before: Each messenger independently meets an adverse response.
changed_reading.after: Each arrival re-enters a standing ignition circuit: communication is converted into denial or lethal conflict, while restraint must come from outside that response loop.

context_deltas.mechanism: 5:66-68 arrange revelation as a structure that descends, must be stood up, is conveyed through a protected carrier, and gives the community something to stand on. This turns the focus's covenant-plus-messengers into a maintained delivery infrastructure rather than two historical favors.

activation_trace.role: Firmness and structural integrity supply the covenant's load-bearing function.
Messenger and carried message supply the human relay within the structure.
Standing upright gives إقامة a constructive role: transmitted material must be erected and maintained.
Bringing down and delivering supplies the vertical input to the relay.
Conveying the message to its endpoint defines the carrier's non-optional function.
Protective holding preserves the carrier long enough for delivery to reach its endpoint.

structural_cues: 5:66 conditions nourishment from above and below on establishing the transmitted books.
5:67 makes delivery exhaustive and pairs it with protection of the messenger.
5:68 says the addressees have no standing until they establish what was sent down to them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies descent, establishment, conveyance, protection, and standing; I join them as one delivery-and-support system. A live alternative is that these are adjacent duties and promises rather than a single mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The covenant and the messengers are separate items in a historical list.
changed_reading.after: The covenant is the support structure for a protected transmission relay; rejection breaks the community's own means of standing up what reaches it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately after the focus, assuming that no assay will occur leads into blindness and deafness, restoration, and repeated blindness and deafness. The appetite gate is sharpened into sensory auto-closure: expectation of immunity from testing disables the channels by which a messenger could challenge the self.

activation_trace.role: Inner inclination supplies the preference that motivates closing against dissonant content.
The inward mind supplies the site whose preferences govern reception.
Supposition supplies the mistaken expectation that no disruptive test will follow.
Assaying metal or a person makes messenger encounter a test of what the covenant community contains.
Blindness of heart and insight supplies repeated visual closure to corrective evidence.
Loss of hearing and refusal to listen supply repeated auditory closure to the messenger's content.

structural_cues: The فَ sequence moves from expecting no test directly into blindness and deafness.
ثُمَّ marks restoration and then a second sensory shutdown, echoing the focus's every-time pattern.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies expectation, assay, sensory closure, restoration, and relapse; I infer an auto-protective reception loop. Blindness and deafness may alternatively name consequences rather than chosen defenses.

changed_reading.before: The self consciously dislikes a message and chooses one of two overt reprisals.
changed_reading.after: Before overt reprisal, the self can protect its preference by disabling recognition itself; even restored reception can relapse when the next test arrives.

context_deltas.mechanism: 5:77 repeats desire but makes it followable: a prior people's inclinations become a track that later people trail, reproduce, and extend by leading many away. The focus's preference filter is therefore socially inherited, not merely private psychology.

activation_trace.role: The self's inclination supplies the focus's immediate rejection criterion.
The inward faculty is the local carrier through which the wider social pattern is enacted.
Plural inclinations turn the focus's private preference into transmissible group material.
Following behind supplies the copying relation by which one generation's desires guide another.
Deviation from guidance supplies the repeated state, transmission to many, and renewed outcome.
An extended traveled road makes social desire function as a route rather than a momentary impulse.

structural_cues: 5:77 orders following before three linked forms of going astray: prior deviation, causing many to deviate, and deviation from the even road.
The plural أَهْوَاءَ قَوْمٍ gives the desire a group source and a history.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies desire, following, repeated deviation, and road; I infer a path-dependent transmission mechanism. A live alternative is ordinary moral imitation without a specific reception loop.

changed_reading.before: Each receiver independently compares a messenger's words with personal preference.
changed_reading.after: The preference has a social genealogy: inherited desires pre-shape what feels welcome, so each new rejection can continue and widen an older path.

context_deltas.mechanism: In the focus, messengers are sent toward the receivers and come carrying what their selves reject; in 5:80, those same selves are grammatical agents of what they have advanced for themselves. The self is not only an inbound taste filter but an outbound dispatcher that sends its chosen future ahead.

activation_trace.role: Sending supplies the inbound dispatch directed toward the covenant community.
Coming with content supplies what reaches the self from outside.
The inward faculty first appears as the evaluator of inbound content.
The persons themselves become the source of the outbound action, reversing their earlier receptive position.
Advancing forward supplies the opposite-direction dispatch whose result awaits the self.

structural_cues: 5:70 directs sending and coming toward them, with their selves as evaluators.
5:80 makes their selves the subject of what is sent or advanced ahead for them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposite directions and repeats the self; I infer a transport symmetry in which reception choices become outbound consequences. Alternatively, قَدَّمَتْ may simply denote accumulated deeds without echoing messenger dispatch.

changed_reading.before: The self is a passive appetite that blocks unwanted arrivals.
changed_reading.after: The self is a two-way gate: it rejects what is sent in and thereby advances its own freight toward the future.

context_deltas.mechanism: 5:83-84 supplies the opposite reception circuit: hearing becomes understanding, recognition releases bodily overflow, speech confesses, and the hearers request inscription with witnesses while hoping to enter a sound community. Desire is not removed; hope redirects it from vetoing incoming truth toward incorporation by it.

activation_trace.role: Inclination supplies the negative reception gate that the later circuit reorients rather than erases.
The focus's partition into destructive outcomes provides the group-forming problem answered by inscription and entry.
Hearing as understanding and compliance opens the channel closed in the negative circuit.
Easy abundant flow makes the body release tears instead of acting against the bearer.
Recognition by trace or sign supplies the discriminating act that replaces appetite-only sorting.
Entering a name in a register or company supplies constructive group formation with the witnesses.
What has come from truth directly mirrors the focus's arriving content but receives welcome.
Heartfelt hope redirects desire toward belonging rather than rejection.
Entry into an interior supplies the desired receptive destination.
A human community supplies the positive collective into which the hearers seek incorporation.

structural_cues: 5:83 chains hearing, bodily overflow, recognition, confession, and a request to be written with witnesses.
5:84 turns what came from truth into hope for entry among the sound community.
5:86 returns denial as the alternative reception branch.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered positive sequence; I read it as a causal countercircuit to 5:70. Tears, confession, inscription, and entry could alternatively be parallel signs rather than successive stages.

changed_reading.before: The focus sounds like a fixed identity verdict in which incoming truth necessarily meets appetite and violence.
changed_reading.after: The focus maps one reception circuit, not an immutable identity: the same arrival can be understood, recognized, embodied as tears, confessed, and used to form a new affiliation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because 5:70 explicitly names denial and killing, not elevation of a messenger. It remains anchored in the distinction between رَسُول and what comes بِمَا, and 5:72-75 explicitly juxtaposes association claims with the correction that the Messiah is only a messenger who eats and whose predecessors passed. Downstream prose should present it only as an exploratory reception analogue, not as a hidden third verb in 5:70.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: رَسُولٌ بِمَا distinguishes bearer from carried content, while يَقْتُلُونَ shows one response directed at the bearer's body.

activation_trace.role: Messenger and message supply the carrier-content distinction on which the outlier depends.
Taking the carrier's life supplies the focus's direct bodily distortion of reception.
Speech as belief or doctrine carries both the identity claim and the messenger's corrective claim.
Association with God supplies the contextual form of overattachment that collapses bearer into referent.
The explicit messenger classification restores the carrier role against that collapse.
The passing of earlier generations places this bearer back inside a temporal messenger succession.
Eating food insists on the bearer's embodied creaturely condition.

changed_reading.before: An unwelcome messenger is either discredited or bodily removed.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the context reveals an inverse distortion: a receiver may preserve and magnify the bearer while severing him from the message-bearing role, another way of refusing what came with him.

strongest_changes: The repeated كُلَّمَا at 5:64 turns every messenger arrival into part of a wider ignition-and-interruption cycle rather than an isolated rejection.
5:63 and 5:79 relocate denial and killing inside a failed social restraint network, while 5:77 shows the appetite filter traveling as an inherited path.
5:80 reverses direction: selves that reject what is sent toward them also advance their own freight ahead.
5:83-84 supplies a full countercircuit in which arrival becomes understanding, recognition, bodily release, confession, inscription, and entry.
summary.what_was_special: Focus-only syntax first made the arriving messengers, not two audience factions, the repeated فَرِيقًا objects. Context then exposed several mechanisms around that sorter: rival ways of taking, delivery infrastructure, sensory closure, absent social brakes, inherited desire, directional reversal, and a constructive reception path.
remaining_uncertainties: The causal link between messenger rejection and 5:64's war ignition is abductive; the two كُلَّمَا sequences may only be structural parallels.
The perfect-imperfect contrast between كَذَّبُوا and يَقْتُلُونَ may mark open habitual violence, but vivid historical narration remains possible.
The overattachment outlier must remain a qualified carrier-content analogy and not be inserted as an unspoken third outcome in 5:70.
